description: Plate shield tank. Shieldgore banks Deathfire, Suffuse spends it to heal you, and block, critical block and absorbs stack on top. Every imp you have out is mitigation.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_knight-of-xoroth__defiance.txt and the defiance block of talents/knight-of-xoroth.json. CoA rates it Dungeon A / Raid C and calls it 'Closest to Blood Death Knight, with a strong secondary nod to Vengeance Demon Hunter' - 'the core identifying loop sits close to Death Strike's math: build a stacking resource off your own weapon-swing abilities (Shieldgore to Demonfire), then dump it into a self-heal'. Its stat priority is Defense (to crit-immunity) > Stamina > Dodge > Parry > Block > Strength > Armor, which is why this tree buys avoidance (Xorothian Finesse) and Stamina before block, and why Strength is spent through a conversion (Hellfire Resolve) rather than taken raw. CoA's listed weaknesses are honoured rather than patched: no node here heals or shields an ally, and nothing in it breaks crowd control.

nodes.name: Hellsmelted Armor
nodes.description: Increases your chance to block by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each Hellfire Imp active now increases your chance to block by 1%.' Per-imp scaling has no hook, so it is flat block chance. Note block is TWO stats here: `block` is the shield-gated CHANCE, block value is the flat amount absorbed (block_value_pct).

nodes.name: Demonfire Plating
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 1% and increases your Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Reduces your damage taken by -2% and increases your Stamina by 3%.' NOTE the two keys use opposite conventions - damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION (-0.01 = -1%) and stamina_pct is percentage POINTS (2.0 = +2%).

nodes.name: A Gift from Hell
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike, Meatsaw, and Melt by -10.' Ability.talented_cost does cost * (1 - pct), so a POSITIVE value is the discount; authored negative it becomes a surcharge.

nodes.name: Hellfire Forgemaster
nodes.description: Increases the damage your blocks absorb by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your block value by 20%.' Block VALUE, the other half of the two-stat block system - a fraction, not percentage points.

nodes.name: Shieldgore
nodes.description: Teaches Shieldgore, a high-threat shield strike that burns and banks 20 Deathfire.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Transforms your Infernal Strike into Shieldgore'. A free spec pick in CoA and the button the entire rotation is built on, so it is the first real node in the tree.

nodes.name: Imp Guards
nodes.description: Reduces the physical damage you take by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each Hellfire Imp now reduces your Physical damage taken by 1%.' Flat, since nothing can read a live pet count. CoA gives this free at level 20.

nodes.name: Imp Aura
nodes.description: Reduces the magic damage you take by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each Hellfire Imp now reduces your Magic damage taken by 1%.' The magic half of Imp Guards, and the reason CoA says this tank 'covers magic as well as melee'.

nodes.name: Xorothian Finesse
nodes.description: Increases your chance to parry by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Increases your chance to parry by 5%.' Parry is full avoidance, unlike block, and CoA's stat priority puts Dodge and Parry above Block.

nodes.name: Hellfire Resolve
nodes.description: Grants block value equal to 3% of your Strength, and 1 hit rating, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your block rating by 15% of your Strength and increases your hit rating by 5% of your Strength.' The block half is a real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion resolved against character.py's shared STAT_CONVERSION maps. The hit half cannot be: hit_rating is a local feeding base_miss_chance_*, not a Character attribute, so it is flat hit instead - the same wall Guardian's Bulwark hit.

nodes.name: Demonfire Retaliation
nodes.description: Taking a hit has a 10% chance per rank to bank 8 Deathfire.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Grants you a 30% chance to generate a stack of Demonfire when attacked.' Literal: a real grant_resource proc into the secondary pool. Proc chance is scaled by points_spent on a multi-rank node (Character._sync_talent_procs), so 10 here is 30% at 3 points.

nodes.name: Forgefiend's Bulwark
nodes.description: Taking a hit has a 10% chance per rank to enrage you, increasing your damage by 10% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Successful blocks, parries and dodges now have a 30% chance to Enrage you, increasing your damage dealt by 10% for 10 seconds.' There is no on-block trigger, so on_damage_taken stands in for the whole block/parry/dodge set.

nodes.name: Black Skull Shield
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shieldgore by 8% and reduces its Rage cost by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Rage cost of Shieldgore by -5 and increases its damage by 25%.' Both halves literal. ability_<id>_<stat> keys are built by interpolation in abilities.py, so a literal grep calls them dead.

nodes.name: Demonic Bulwark
nodes.description: Your blocks absorb an additional 5% of the damage dealt to you, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your successful blocks now have a 30% chance to critically block for twice the normal amount.' block_bonus_reduction is the engine's existing critical-block hook, read in Character.take_damage. The chance roll becomes a flat bonus.

nodes.name: Infernal Bulwark
nodes.description: Unleash Pestilence banks 20 Deathfire and increases the damage your blocks absorb by 20% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Unleash Pestilence now generates 4 stacks of Demonfire and grants Infernal Bulwark: increases block value by 20% for 18 seconds.' Both halves literal, with ability_filter restricting the trigger to Unleash Pestilence itself.

nodes.name: Brimstone Buckler
nodes.description: Taking a hit has a 10% chance per rank to call a Hellfire Imp.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Successful blocks now have a 30% chance to summon 1 Hellfire Imp to aid you in battle for 12 seconds. Can only occur once every 3 sec.' cast_ability fires the real summon, so the imp is a real pet; the icd is the 3-second lockout. on_damage_taken stands in for the missing on-block trigger.

nodes.name: Hellfire Sieger
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you take 8% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Doubles the absorption of Black Shield while below 35% health.' Nothing can double an absorb conditionally, so the node keeps the 35% threshold and pays out as the engine's low-health mitigation pair instead. low_health_threshold_pct is in UNSCALED_EFFECT_KEYS, so it stays 35% at every rank.

nodes.name: Demolisher
nodes.description: Increases your threat generation by 8% and reduces the physical damage you take by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Flesh Hook or Chainwhip now taunts the target for 2 seconds and reduces your Physical damage taken by -5% for 10 seconds.' A talent cannot add a taunt to an existing ability (that is what the kit's Dread is for), so this is the tree's threat node. 8% per rank over 3 ranks is +24%, the same band as Warrior Protection's Defiance and Guardian Vanguard's Footman's Call, so the three plate tanks hold threat equally. Note the key: threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and percentage POINTS as an ability buff stat_mod.

nodes.name: Soul Furnace
nodes.description: Your heals have a 34% chance per rank to leave a shield absorbing 15% of the amount healed.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Sacrificial Circle now grants you a damage absorption shield equal to 15% of the total health of each destroyed imp for 10 sec.' Imp health is not readable from a proc; shield_pct sizes the absorb off the heal that triggered it, which is the same 'heal, then keep part of it as armour' shape.

nodes.name: Warden of Hellfire
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Skulltaker and Flames of Xoroth by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage dealt by Skulltaker and Flames of Xoroth by 20%.' Literal.

nodes.name: Imp Gang Boss
nodes.description: Increases your pets' damage and health by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Call: Hellfire Imp now summons 2 additional imps', plus Demonic Grit's '+15% total health'. The engine supports one pet at a time, so more imps is not available; a bigger, tougher imp is.

nodes.name: Hellwrath
nodes.description: Increases the amount Black Shield absorbs by 10% and your Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Demon's Blood can now stack 5 additional times and each stack now increases the absorption amount of Black Shield by 1%.' Demon's Blood has no engine hook, so the node pays the absorb directly. ability_<id>_potency is the buff-magnitude key, read in the buff branch of Ability._apply_effect.

nodes.name: Fiery Retribution
nodes.description: Taking a hit has a 15% chance per rank to refresh Sacrificial Circle and Implosion.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each time a Hellfire Imp dies, you reduce the cooldown of Sacrificial Circle by -2 sec and Implosion by -1 sec.' There is no on-pet-death trigger, so it fires off damage taken instead - which is when an imp would have died. reset_cooldown is a real proc payload and takes a list.

nodes.name: Call: Hellfire Abyssal
nodes.description: Teaches Call: Hellfire Abyssal. While you fight, you and your allies take 5% less damage.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Call down a Hellfire Abyssal ... emits an aura that reduces the damage taken by party and raid members within 40 yds by 5%.' A talent's effects apply to the Knight only, so the 5% is personal rather than party-wide - the ally half is the one piece of this node the engine cannot carry.
